# hoop_access_request_rule (Resource)

Manages an access request rule: who approves access, and for how long. With `access_type` `jit`, `command` or `jit_command` the rule gates the connections in `connection_names`. With `access_type` `sidecar` it gates no connection: it is the policy a sidecar review is filed under, named by `approval_rule` in an analyzer rule's `sidecar_spec`, and says who may release a statement the sidecar held. An analyzer rule that holds under its own name gets such a rule created and managed by the gateway; this resource is for a rule several analyzer rules share.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Who may release a statement a sidecar held. Several analyzer rules name it
# through approval_rule in their sidecar_spec.
resource "hoop_access_request_rule" "dba_approvals" {
  name             = "dba-approvals"
  description      = "DBA leads release statements the sidecars hold"
  access_type      = "sidecar"
  reviewers_groups = ["dba-leads"]
  min_approvals    = 1
  pending_ttl_sec  = 900 # a held statement waits 15 minutes for a decision
  approval_ttl_sec = 600 # an approval is good for 10 minutes
}

resource "hoop_ai_session_analyzer_rule" "appdb" {
  name = "appdb-analysis"

  risk_evaluation = {
    low_risk    = { action = "allow_execution" }
    medium_risk = { action = "allow_execution" }
    high_risk   = { action = "block_execution" }
  }

  sidecar_spec = jsonencode({
    trigger       = "statement"
    high          = "require_review"
    approval_rule = hoop_access_request_rule.dba_approvals.name
  })

  sidecar_targets = [{ sidecar_id = hoop_sidecar.payments.id, listener_name = "appdb" }]
}

# A connection rule: production databases need two approvals from SRE.
resource "hoop_access_request_rule" "prod_jit" {
  name                     = "prod-jit"
  access_type              = "jit"
  connection_names         = [hoop_connection.pg_prod.name]
  approval_required_groups = ["developers"]
  reviewers_groups         = ["sre"]
  force_approval_groups    = ["admin"]
  min_approvals            = 2
  access_max_duration      = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_type` (String) One of `jit`, `command`, `jit_command` or `sidecar`. A change replaces the rule.
- `name` (String) The unique name of the rule. The gateway addresses the rule by it, so a change replaces the rule.

### Optional

- `access_max_duration` (Number) Maximum access duration in seconds, for connection rules.
- `all_groups_must_approve` (Boolean) When true, one approval from each of `reviewers_groups` is needed and `min_approvals` is ignored.
- `approval_required_groups` (List of String) User groups whose members need approval. Empty makes every requester need approval.
- `approval_ttl_sec` (Number) Seconds a sidecar approval lasts, 60 to 604800. Sidecar rules only.
- `attributes` (List of String) Attribute names this rule is associated with.
- `connection_names` (List of String) The connections this rule gates. Required, or `attributes`, unless `access_type` is `sidecar`, which refuses it.
- `description` (String) The rule description.
- `force_approval_groups` (List of String) Groups whose members may approve on their own.
- `min_approvals` (Number) Approvals needed before access is granted. At least 1 unless `all_groups_must_approve`.
- `pending_ttl_sec` (Number) Seconds a sidecar review may wait for a decision, 60 to 604800. Sidecar rules only.
- `reviewers_groups` (List of String) Groups whose members may approve. At least one for a connection rule; for a sidecar rule, empty means the admin group reviews.
- `skip_review_groups` (List of String) Groups whose members skip the review. Only with an empty `approval_required_groups`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.
- `managed_by` (String) `hoop` for a protection profile's rule, `ai-session-analyzer` for the rule an analyzer rule holds under, empty otherwise. A managed rule accepts changes to its groups and approval counts only, and cannot be deleted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# The gateway addresses the rule by name.
terraform import hoop_access_request_rule.dba_approvals dba-approvals
```
